facts.business: Patspin India Limited is a company engaged in manufacturing operations, likely in the textile sector given references to cotton prices and VRS measures.

auditor.name: L.U. KRISHNAN & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to total comprehensive loss of Rs 1,114 lakhs, cash loss of Rs 822 lakhs, eroded net worth, and sub-standard lender accounts since 2021; however, opinion not modified as management has submitted a resolution plan for debt restructuring with bankers pursuing further process after TEV study confirmed viability.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to accumulated losses, eroded net worth, and sub-standard lender accounts
Revenue recognition risk around year-end without substantial transfer of control
Dependence on successful debt restructuring with lenders for continued operations
facts.related_party_note: No transactions with companies struck off under section 248 of Companies Act, 2013 or section 560 of Companies Act, 1956; no advances or loans to intermediaries for benefit of ultimate beneficiaries; no funds received from funding parties with understanding to lend/invest on their behalf.
